visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a black V-neck sweater and a silver necklace, sits on a gray fabric couch. She faces the camera directly, her mouth moving in speech. Behind her, a neon sign glows red with Chinese characters inside a frame. The background is a plain off-white wall, creating a clean studio-like environment. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a white textured notebook. On the page, black text reads 'Quantum AI' above a stylized circular logo and the word 'Willow.' The lighting is bright and even. The camera is static, focusing on the printed text and minimalist graphic design. (3) A wide landscape shot displays a grassy field by a body of water under a dim, twilight sky. A semi-transparent graphic overlay shows a square processor chip labeled with a logo and 'Willow.' Glowing vertical lines connect icons representing quantum computing and wireless signals, suggesting a digital network integration. (4) Back to the woman on the couch, she continues speaking, using her hands to gesture in a circular motion. Her facial expression is focused and informative. The lighting remains soft and warm, highlighting her features against the dim neon sign in the background. (5) A top-down close-up view shows three electronic memory chips or SIM card contacts arranged on a dark, textured surface. The gold-colored contact pads are prominent. The lighting is harsh and directional, emphasizing the metallic textures and the small components of the integrated circuits. (6) The screen transitions to a dark blue digital background filled with glowing numbers and mathematical symbols. Various colorful cryptocurrency logos, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Litecoin, float and rotate slowly in the foreground. The visual style is sleek and technological, representing digital finance. (7) Returning to the main subject, she continues her explanation. Text overlays such as '(ECDSA 256)' and '(SHA-256)' appear near her shoulders in white font. She maintains steady eye contact with the camera, her hands moving rhythmically with her speech to emphasize points. (8) The final phase shows the woman leaning slightly forward on the couch. She breaks her serious expression with a wide, friendly smile and a brief laugh. The neon sign '理科' remains illuminated behind her as the video concludes, maintaining the consistent visual theme established at the beginning.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 不知道大家有沒有聽說. [Logo]: 理科. (2) [Subtitle]: Google最近成功推出了叫做 Willow 的量子晶片. [Slogan]: WILLOW 量子晶片. (3) [Subtitle]: 有買加密貨幣的人可能需要有點小小的擔心了. (4) [Subtitle]: 這個晶片擁有 105 個量子位元, 能在 5 分鐘之內完成傳統超級電腦需耗時 10 的 25 次方年才能達成的運算任務. (5) [Subtitle]: 雖然這個量子晶片還非常的原始. (6) [Subtitle]: 量子電腦要達到能夠破解加密貨幣所使用的加密技術還有許多挑戰需要被克服. (7) [Subtitle]: 像是比特幣主要依賴 (ECDSA 256) 橢圓曲線數位簽章算法, 還有安全雜湊演算算法 (SHA-256). (8) [Subtitle]: 我是有買 GOOGLE 的股票啦. [Variety]: (笑).
